=== Expand all opens three folded levels in one call
--- given
- a‸ ⊟
  - b ⊟
    - c ⊟
      - d
- e
--- when command expand-all
--- then
- a‸
  - b
    - c
      - d
- e

=== Collapse all closes three levels in one call
--- given
- a‸
  - b
    - c
      - d
- e
--- when command collapse-all
--- then
- a‸ ⊟
  - b ⊟
    - c ⊟
      - d
- e

=== Collapse all leaves childless items alone
--- given
- a‸
  - b
  - c
    - d
--- when command collapse-all
--- then
- a‸ ⊟
  - b
  - c ⊟
    - d

=== Expand all on an item with one folded grandchild opens it
--- given
- a‸
  - b ⊟
    - c
--- when command expand-all
--- then
- a‸
  - b
    - c

=== Collapse all moves a cursor off a line that is about to be hidden
--- given
- a
  - b‸
    - c
--- when command collapse-all
--- then
- a
  - b‸ ⊟
    - c

=== Collapse all from a notes line moves the cursor to the end of the item's line
--- given
- a
  no‸te
  - b
--- when command collapse-all
--- then
- a‸ ⊟
  note
  - b

=== Collapse all with whole items selected folds every selected subtree
--- given
⟨- a
  - a1
    - a2
- b
  - b1⟩
- c
--- when command collapse-all
--- then
⟨- a ⊟
  - a1 ⊟
    - a2
- b ⊟
  - b1⟩
- c

=== Expand all with whole items selected opens every selected subtree
--- given
⟨- a ⊟
  - a1 ⊟
    - a2
- b ⊟
  - b1⟩
- c
--- when command expand-all
--- then
⟨- a
  - a1
    - a2
- b
  - b1⟩
- c

=== Expand all leaves an already open subtree alone
--- given
- a‸
  - b
--- when command expand-all
--- then
- a‸
  - b
